hooks.command: [ -z "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" ] || ! cmp -s "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"/.claude/settings.json "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.claude/settings.json || exit 0; m=$(jq -ner 'input | select(has("agent_type") and (.agent_type | endswith("critic"))) | .tool_input.message // ""') || { [ $? = 4 ] && exit 0; exit 2; }; printf %s "$m" | "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}"/.agent/scripts/verdict || exit 2
